prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet photo validation stage: Insert a dedicated photo clarity verification screen before certificate generation to prevent custom pet visual glitches or setup failures.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_check": {"headline": "Verify Photo Quality", "body": "Make sure your uploaded photo is clear and well-lit to ensure your desktop pet generates properly.", "button_label": "Looks Good", "layout": "centered"}}
1: [finish, redesign] Stage layout for home introduction: Redesign the home_intro screen into a stage layout emphasizing key desktop controls and interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready for Desktop Life", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, or minimize your new companion anytime from your desktop taskbar."}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering pipeline explanation notice: Display step-by-step rendering engine startup notices on the waiting screen while the pet initializes on screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Building Desktop Companion Surface", "body": "1. Initializing graphics engine. 2. Anchoring companion overlay. 3. Finalizing interactive animations."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Position sign-in screen before path selection: Move sign-in to occur right after the story screen so user account sync is established prior to pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, copy] Multi-device pet save reassurance text: Update the sign-in prompt body text to explicitly clarify that logging in preserves pet progress across reinstallations and device changes.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Signing in secures your pet's memory, traits, and progress across device reinstalls and upgrades."}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Path selection flexibility hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that choosing a premade path does not prevent users from making custom pets later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can always create additional custom pets or adjust settings after onboarding!"}}
6: [adoption, layout] Split layout for adoption certificate screen: Switch adoption certificate layout to split view, presenting companion stats side-by-side with certificate details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Desktop Adoption Certificate"}}
7: [home, new_flow] Companion quick summon diagnostic flow: Add an interactive quick-summon button component on the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Test Desktop Overlay", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
8: [finish, incentive] First care accessory completion reward: Highlight an exclusive starter toy item unlocked on the final onboarding screen to incentivize completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Onboarding Complete: Starter Toy Unlocked!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Toy Claimed", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop notification toggle on final view: Enable a desktop notification toggle on the finish screen so users stay alerted when their desktop pet needs care.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Enable notifications so your companion can alert you on your desktop when it wants to play."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a photo clarity check screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning the home intro screen while keeping its core function is permitted under rules 2 and 4.
Updating waiting screen information and status notices is allowed under rule 4.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted by rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to clarify device sync features is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a helpful hint to the choose path screen is permitted and maintains all core requirements.
Switching to a split layout for the adoption certificate screen is allowed under rule 4.
Adding a next action button to the waiting screen makes the mandatory waiting step skippable.
Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, unlocked items, or free extras.
Adding notification settings on the home intro screen is allowed under rule 4.
